item.text:
**7B.4**
Verdict: mixed, leaning negative.

Search gap: I did not find a solid 2024 source proving AMLO personally took bribes, held hidden assets, or ran an opaque personal foundation. The strongest evidence is indirect but significant: allegations around relatives and close associates, plus reforms and surveillance practices that made conflicts of interest harder to police.

**Negative**
- **[El clan: los primos de Andy y “Bobby” López Beltrán, y sus contratos en el gobierno de AMLO](https://latinus.us/mexico/2024/2/20/el-clan-los-primos-de-andy-bobby-lopez-beltran-sus-contratos-en-el-gobierno-de-amlo-108263.html)** - LatinUS, 2024-02-20. Investigation alleges a family-linked network around AMLO’s sons touched Tren Maya and Pemex contracting, which is direct allegation-level evidence of close-family profit from office. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`.
- **[Quién es Osterlen Salazar Beltrán, el primo de los hijos de AMLO señalado por tener contratos millonarios con Pemex](https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2024/02/21/quien-es-osterlen-salazar-beltran-el-primo-de-los-hijos-de-amlo-senalado-por-tener-contratos-millonarios-con-pemex/)** - Infobae, 2024-02-21. Report says relatives of AMLO’s sons won Pemex contracts through a family company, another concrete allegation of insider access and hidden conflicts. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`.
- **[Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with supermajority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906)** - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-06-04. Reuters reported AMLO pushed an INE overhaul critics saw as a way to cement Morena’s hegemony, which points to using state design for coalition advantage rather than clean separation from personal/political interest. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`.
- **[Mexico’s sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588)** - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-15. Reuters said the overhaul weakened judicial independence and investor confidence, making it harder to police self-dealing or punish conflicts of interest. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`.
- **[Mexico: Proposed Constitutional Changes Threaten Rights](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights)** - Human Rights Watch, 2024-08-30. HRW warned the package would weaken accountability and abolish transparency/privacy safeguards, increasing the risk that conflicts of interest or privileged access could stay hidden. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`.
- **[Mexico: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-net/2024)** - Freedom House, 2024. Freedom House reported a covert SEDENA cyberspace unit monitored critics and used inauthentic accounts, with little oversight, which is relevant as opaque state power can protect hidden conflicts and punish exposure. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.2`, `7B.3`.

**Positive**
- **[Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasion fiscal de Totalplay debe mas de mil 500 millones de pesos al SAT](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/)** - Presidencia de México, 2024-03-15. The government publicly pursued a tax-evasion case against a politically connected company, which is evidence against routine favoritism toward insiders. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`.
- **[Gobierno de México mantiene demanda en Florida para recuperar 634 mdd por trama de corrupción de García Luna](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-de-mexico-mantiene-demanda-en-florida-para-recuperar-634-mdd-por-trama-de-corrupcion-de-garcia-luna/)** - Presidencia de México, 2024-02-16. The administration continued asset-recovery litigation tied to a corruption network, which is at least some evidence of using state power against corruption rather than for private gain. IDs: `7B.4`.
- **[Entrega directa de programas para el bienestar abate la corrupción](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/entrega-directa-de-programas-para-el-bienestar-abate-la-corrupcion/)** - Programas para el Bienestar, 2024-10-17. The government said direct deposits to Banco del Bienestar cards eliminated intermediaries and commissions, reducing a common channel for patronage and hidden take. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`.
- **[AMLO rechaza que sus hijos hagan negocio con balasto del Tren Maya](https://www.publimetro.com.mx/nacional/2024/04/03/amlo-rechaza-que-sus-hijos-hagan-negocio-con-balasto-del-tren-maya/)** - Publimetro México, 2024-04-03. AMLO publicly denied that his sons were using the Tren Maya for business and challenged accusers to produce proof; this is limited counterevidence, but it is self-interested and not independently verified. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`, `7B.2`.
- **[29.04.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/29-04-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/)** - Presidencia de México, 2024-04-29. AMLO denied his sons were involved in Tren Maya business and said he would not intervene for them, which is weak but relevant counterevidence against family profiteering. IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`, `7B.2`.

Bottom line: the record does not show clear proof of AMLO personally enriching himself, but it does show credible 2024 allegations about close-family contracting and a broader pattern of weakening the institutions that would normally expose or punish hidden conflicts.
